lead.headline: Securitize NYSE Debut Signals Institutional Tokenization Pivot
lead.tldr: The public listing of Securitize and Ondo's expansion into equity tokenization mark a shift from experimental pilots to regulated, public-market infrastructure for RWA.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, here is what moved in Web3 over the last 24 hours and why it matters for the quarter ahead.

top_signals.title: Securitize Debuts on NYSE, Issues Tokenized Stocks
top_signals.summary: Securitize has officially debuted on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE). To mark the occasion, the company issued tokenized versions of its own shares on the Solana and Avalanche blockchains.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Issuing tokenized shares of a public company on Solana and Avalanche creates a live test case for secondary market liquidity of equity tokens.

top_signals.title: Securitize is latest crypto company to go public as BlackRock-backed firm sees stock jump 3% on debut
top_signals.summary: Securitize, a BlackRock-backed tokenization firm, has gone public via a merger with a special-purpose acquisition company. The company raised $400 million during the process and saw its stock price increase by 3% on its debut.
top_signals.why_it_matters: A $400M public debut for a BlackRock-backed firm validates the valuation premiums currently available for compliant tokenization platforms.

top_signals.title: Ondo tokenizes BlackRock's IVV ETF and Micron stock under US custodial model
top_signals.summary: Ondo Finance has expanded its tokenization offerings by bringing BlackRock's IVV ETF and Micron stock onto the blockchain. The assets are managed under an SEC-defined custodial model with settlement occurring on the Ethereum network.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Ondo's use of an SEC-defined custodial model for IVV and Micron stock demonstrates the viable path for bringing high-cap equities on-chain.

top_signals.title: Standard Chartered, Circle Bring USDC Into Banking System
top_signals.summary: Standard Chartered and Circle have partnered to integrate USDC minting and redemption directly into the banking system for institutional clients. The initiative is launching initially in the UAE, bridging traditional finance with stablecoin infrastructure.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Direct USDC integration into Standard Chartered's banking system removes the friction of off-ramps for institutional treasury management.

top_signals.title: IMF Says Tokenization Could Reshape Global Finance, Warns of New Risks
top_signals.summary: The IMF warns that policymakers have a limited timeframe to regulate tokenized finance as global banks and infrastructure providers accelerate blockchain adoption. While acknowledging the potential to reshape global finance, the organization emphasizes the need to mitigate emerging systemic risks.
top_signals.why_it_matters: The IMF's warning suggests that regulatory frameworks will likely tighten as systemic risk from tokenized assets becomes a priority for central banks.

deals.summary: Securitize, a BlackRock-backed tokenization firm, has gone public via a merger with a special-purpose acquisition company. The company raised $400 million during the process and saw its stock price increase by 3% on its debut.

Venice AI, founded by Erik Voorhees, has secured $65 million in Series A funding. The company has reached a $1 billion valuation as investors bet on the demand for privacy-centric artificial intelligence.

eToro has led a $12.5 million funding round for Extended, an on-chain perpetual exchange. The partnership aims to leverage next-generation on-chain infrastructure to expand access to global financial markets.

Ark Invest has acquired $18 million in shares of Circle following a significant dip in the company's stock value. The decline is attributed in part to the launch of a competing stablecoin project, OUSD.

on_the_radar.title: Humanity Protocol repositions toward enterprise AI after $36 million hack, founder says
on_the_radar.summary: Humanity Protocol is pivoting its focus toward enterprise AI following a $36 million exploit. Founder Terence Kwok indicated that the likelihood of recovering the stolen funds is low.

on_the_radar.title: Peter Thiel-backed crypto-friendly Erebor Bank eyes $8 billion valuation as deposits nearly quadruple: Bloomberg
on_the_radar.summary: Erebor Bank, a crypto-friendly financial institution backed by Peter Thiel and Palmer Luckey, is seeking new funding. The bank is targeting a valuation of at least $8 billion following a significant increase in deposits.

on_the_radar.title: UK payments blueprint outlines tokenized payments for ‘multi-money ecosystem’24m, UK payments blueprint outlines tokenized payments for ‘multi-money ecosystem’UK regulators published an update to a national retail payments blueprint, calling for infrastructure support for tokenization and interoperability with new forms of digital money.
on_the_radar.summary: UK regulators have updated their national retail payments blueprint to advocate for infrastructure that supports tokenization. The goal is to create a 'multi-money ecosystem' that ensures interoperability between traditional and new forms of digital money.

on_the_radar.title: Why CFOs should pay attention to Open USD—the new stablecoin backed by more than 140 companies
on_the_radar.summary: A new stablecoin consortium called Open USD has been launched with the backing of over 140 companies. The initiative aims to allow banks and fintechs to convert idle settlement cash into yield-generating digital assets.

on_the_radar.title: OFAC sanctions 134 ISIS-K crypto wallet addresses as Tether freezes funds27m, OFAC sanctions 134 ISIS-K crypto wallet addresses as Tether freezes funds
on_the_radar.summary: The US Treasury's OFAC has sanctioned 134 cryptocurrency wallet addresses linked to ISIS-K. In response, Tether has frozen funds associated with these addresses to prevent terrorist financing.

on_the_radar.title: Metaplanet adds 2,823 bitcoin to holdings in Q2, bringing total to 43,000 BTC
on_the_radar.summary: Metaplanet significantly increased its Bitcoin holdings during Q2, acquiring an additional 2,823 BTC. This brings the company's total treasury to 43,000 BTC.

on_the_radar.title: Robinhood Backs New DEX Arcus in Partnership With dYdX
on_the_radar.summary: Robinhood has partnered with and backed Arcus, a rebranded version of the dYdX decentralized exchange operating on its own blockchain. The initiative aims to integrate tokenized stocks and perpetuals trading into the ecosystem.

on_the_radar.title: Russia on track for digital ruble rollout on Sept. 1: Central bank governor 18m, Russia on track for digital ruble rollout on Sept. 1: Central bank governor
on_the_radar.summary: The Central Bank of Russia is preparing for the official rollout of the digital ruble starting September 1. This move represents a significant step in the country's transition toward a sovereign digital currency.

linkedin_post:
Securitize going public via a SPAC and raising $400M is a concrete signal that the market is pricing in the 'institutionalization' of tokenization. What I keep coming back to is not the listing itself, but the fact that they issued tokenized versions of their own shares on Solana and Avalanche simultaneously. This isn't a pilot; it is a live integration of public equity and blockchain rails.

When you pair this with Ondo Finance tokenizing BlackRock's IVV ETF and Micron stock under an SEC-defined custodial model, the pattern is clear. We are moving away from niche 'crypto-native' assets and toward a world where the primary value proposition of a blockchain is the efficiency of the ledger for traditional securities. I'd watch how these tokenized shares trade compared to the NYSE ticker to see if we actually get the liquidity and settlement advantages promised by the tech. If the price discovery remains synced and settlement is instant, the incentive for other public firms to follow suit becomes undeniable.
